variants.scalarReuse: current built reader and top-k implementation

comparison.limitation: Baseline reader/top-k modules use current unchanged dependencies; this is a two-module comparison, not a historical whole-revision build.
comparison.reportNote: Descriptive metadata was normalized after measurement; original harness digest and raw timings are preserved. Prototype was rejected and reverted.

description: Alternating unchanged scalar-reader/top-k modules against the experimental current-right scalar memo. Reuse is enabled only after the candidate heap fills and disabled before final sorting. No whole-column or dictionary decoding cache is built. Matrix/cardinality, source/oracle exclusions and measured sample conditions otherwise match the shared harness.
limitations: Sequential synchronous Node selections with retained outputs model reuse/overlap, not asynchronous cloud jobs.
Unicode allocation uses a conservative UTF16 upper bound derived from UTF8 bytes; runtime/native/GC overhead and oracle memory are outside reservation accounting.
Experimental cache only; no production policy or timing threshold inferred from one run.
